entries.e38d9326cb17fa23: Since its founding in 1967, the company has built a track record of more than half a century as a specialist contractor for water and sewerage works. It holds proprietary technologies, including the patented “ＯＬＹ” road surface covering method and the pipe-in-pipe “Pikarus Method,” and the cumulative number of projects using ＯＬＹ exceeds 5,000. It holds an Ａ rank in the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's grading for sewerage works and general civil engineering works.
entries.e74660eb8fd6c38e: The company sets as its basic philosophy “to contribute greatly to people and society through the construction business,” and states that through steady execution of its medium-term management plan “ACTION PLAN 2025,” formulated in 2025, and the practice of sustainability management, it will promote improvement of economic and social value, expansion of growth investment and strengthening of shareholder returns. In the construction business, it plans to focus on winning orders for work centered on mechanical pipe-jacking construction, and to increase the number of construction management engineers and strengthen its construction system.
